messages:
IncidentBot: Pager: High tail latency observed for inference-runtime in eu-west-1 — embedding requests > 2s for 10% of traffic. Pager triggered at 4822107777.
ava_oncall: seeing it. shifting oncall to me. digging into k/v cache hit rate dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/inference/kvcache-eu-west1
ravi_ml: I can help look at batching/quantization metrics. early hypothesis: recent quantized model rollout + batch size auto-tuner change.
diego_sre: confirming increased CPU on routing proxies, and many cache miss spikes around 4822107802.
ava_oncall: running quick remediation: temporarily disable batch auto-tuner for this pool.
jenna_eng: noted. command to rollback autoscaler flag: ```make deploy-config ENV=eu-west1 CONFIG=batch_autotuner=false``` — will run if you give the go.
ava_oncall: go ahead.
ops-bot: Deployment started by jenna_eng at 4822107825. CI passed.
jenna_eng: rollback applied. observing tail latency.
ravi_ml: looking at model variant split: we pushed q4-small as canary 20% yesterday. KV cache keys differ slightly for q4-small -> higher miss rate.
marta_cs: Heads-up: one customer, AcmePay, reported slower embeddings in the EU region via support ticket #3456.
priya_pm: capturing customer impact for postmortem. Marta, can you add support logs to the ticket and tag acct team?
marta_cs: done. added sample payloads and timestamps.
diego_sre: cache hit rate back to normal within ~90s after rollback. proxy CPU dropping. tail latency improving to baseline.
ava_oncall: nice. marking incident as mitigated. IncidentBot: mitigation recorded at 4822107900.
ava_oncall: next steps — we need a post-incident review, RCA on quantized variant and batch tuner interaction, and a remediation plan to avoid future rough rollouts.
ravi_ml: agree. immediate action: revert canary of q4-small to 0% for eu-west1 until we fix cache key normalization. I'll own a fix for key hashing and add unit tests. ETA: 2 working days.
jenna_eng: I'll make batch tuner change gated behind a feature flag and add alerting when tail latency > 1.5s for 5m during config changes. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
diego_sre: I'll add a playbook step: when KV miss rate spikes > 15% for 2m, page eng-oncall and mute autoscaler for that pool. Added as runbook entry RB-71.
ava_oncall: can we schedule the postmortem? suggest 48 hours after incident to allow logs/metrics to stabilize.
priya_pm: I'm scheduling PT-incident-review for Tue 09:30 UTC. Agenda: timeline, customer impact, RCA, action items, owners + due dates.
marta_cs: CS will prep impact summary and affected customers list.
ravi_ml: creating Jira ticket INF-9812 "KV-key normalization + canary safety for quantized variants" and linking logs. Assigning to me + code review owner @jenna_eng. Due in 5d.
jenna_eng: creating Jira INF-9813 "Feature-flag batch-autotuner + latency alert". Assigning to me, reviewers: diego_sre, ravi_ml. Due 3d.
diego_sre: INF-9814 playbook update for KV-miss pager. Assigning to me and ava_oncall. Due 2d.
ava_oncall: adding action item: inform any customers who hit >2s embeddings during window; draft sent for review.
marta_cs: will send customer outreach once we have final incident summary.
ops-bot: Jira links created: https://jira.redwood/browse/INF-9812, INF-9813, INF-9814.
ava_oncall: tagging postmortem owner: @ravi_ml for RCA write-up. Ravi — can you post a draft RFC in #eng-runtime channel before the review?
ravi_ml: yes. I'll post a short draft + proposed fix flow (hashing shim + unit tests + canary checks) by tomorrow morning.
ava_oncall: final check: any data exfil or security concern? security, please chime in if needed.
ops-bot: Security alert scan: no anomalies detected during incident window.
priya_pm: good. I'll pull together the slides and timeline.
ava_oncall: thanks everyone. closing pager. please update Jira tickets as you progress. :thumbsup:
